dental-mirror.definition: A small mirror on a handle used by dental professionals to view areas inside the mouth.
dental-mirror.exampleUsage: The dentist used a dental mirror to examine the back teeth.

probe.definition: An investigation conducted using a flexible surgical instrument to explore an injury or a body cavity.
probe.exampleUsage: The probe was used during the activity.

scaler.definition: An electronic pulse counter used to count pulses that occur too rapidly to be recorded individually.

dental-drill.definition: A powered dental instrument used by trained professionals to remove or shape tooth material during treatment.
dental-drill.exampleUsage: The dental drill is operated only by trained dental professionals.

suction-tube.definition: A narrow tube used during dental treatment to remove saliva, water, and small debris from the mouth.
suction-tube.exampleUsage: The dental assistant positioned the suction tube during the procedure.

polisher.definition: A power tool used to buff surfaces.
polisher.exampleUsage: The polisher was used during the activity.

dental-pick.definition: A small pointed dental instrument used by professionals to examine or clean specific areas around teeth.
dental-pick.exampleUsage: The dentist used a dental pick during the examination.

tweezers.definition: A small tool consisting of two pointed arms used for picking up small objects or plucking hairs.
tweezers.exampleUsage: The tweezers was used during the activity.

syringe.definition: A medical instrument used to inject or withdraw fluids.
syringe.exampleUsage: The syringe was used during the activity.

filling-tool.definition: A dental instrument used by trained professionals to place, shape, or finish filling material.
filling-tool.exampleUsage: The filling tool helped shape the restoration.

excavator.definition: A large machine with a bucket used for digging and moving earth.
excavator.exampleUsage: The excavator was used during the activity.

burnisher.definition: A hand tool with polished agate tips (or other gemstone) for rubbing the gold leaf in order to obtain a highly polished surface, used in gilding.
burnisher.exampleUsage: The burnisher was used during the activity.

amalgam-carrier.definition: A dental instrument designed to carry and place amalgam material into a prepared tooth cavity.
amalgam-carrier.exampleUsage: The dental tray included an amalgam carrier.

dental-spatula.definition: A small dental instrument used to mix or handle certain dental materials.
dental-spatula.exampleUsage: The dental spatula was used to mix the material.

rubber-dam.definition: A thin sheet placed around one or more teeth to keep the treatment area dry and isolated.
rubber-dam.exampleUsage: The dentist placed a rubber dam around the tooth.

bite-block.definition: A small support placed between the teeth to help keep the mouth open during some dental procedures.
bite-block.exampleUsage: The bite block helped the patient rest the jaw during treatment.

matrix-band.definition: A thin temporary band placed around a tooth to help shape and contain restorative material.
matrix-band.exampleUsage: The dentist positioned a matrix band before placing the filling.

dental-chair.definition: An adjustable chair designed to support a patient during dental examinations and treatment.
dental-chair.exampleUsage: The patient sat in the dental chair for the checkup.

overhead-light.definition: A bright adjustable light positioned above a work or treatment area.
overhead-light.exampleUsage: The overhead light illuminated the patient's mouth.

rinse-bowl.definition: A small basin near a dental chair used for rinsing and disposing of water.
rinse-bowl.exampleUsage: The rinse bowl is beside the dental chair.

tray-table.definition: A small table or movable surface used to hold instruments and supplies.
tray-table.exampleUsage: Clean instruments were arranged on the tray table.

monitor.definition: A screen used to display information or images.

x-ray-machine.definition: A device that produces X-rays, allowing images of structures inside the body.
x-ray-machine.exampleUsage: The x-ray machine was used during the activity.

dental-lamp.definition: A bright adjustable lamp used to illuminate the mouth during dental work.
dental-lamp.exampleUsage: The dental lamp was directed toward the treatment area.

foot-pedal.definition: A lever or button pressed by the foot to control a machine, vehicle, or musical instrument.
foot-pedal.exampleUsage: The foot pedal was used during the activity.

armrest.definition: A support beside a seat on which a person rests an arm.

headrest.definition: A cushion attached to the top of the back of an automobile's seat to prevent whiplash.

cuspidor.definition: A receptacle for spit (usually in a public place).

instrument-panel.definition: A flat, insulated control surface holds switches, dials, and meters for operating other electrical equipment.
instrument-panel.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Instrument Panel" in an educational description.

air-water-syringe.definition: A dental device that delivers a controlled stream of air, water, or both during examination and treatment.
air-water-syringe.exampleUsage: The dentist used the air/water syringe to rinse the tooth.

dental-stool.definition: An adjustable stool designed for a dentist or dental assistant to sit on while working.
dental-stool.exampleUsage: The dentist adjusted the height of the dental stool.

sterilizer.definition: A device for heating substances above their boiling point.
sterilizer.exampleUsage: The sterilizer was used during the activity.

autoclave.definition: To subject to the action of an autoclave.

toothbrush.definition: A small brush used with toothpaste to clean your teeth.

toothpaste.definition: A soft substance put on a toothbrush to clean your teeth.

dental-floss.definition: A thin thread used to clean the narrow spaces between your teeth.

mouthwash.definition: A liquid used to rinse the mouth and help keep it clean.

fluoride-gel.definition: A gel containing fluoride used by dental professionals or in approved dental-care products to help strengthen tooth enamel.
fluoride-gel.exampleUsage: The dentist applied fluoride gel as part of preventive care.

dental-wax.definition: A soft wax used in dentistry for purposes such as protecting the mouth from irritating orthodontic appliances or making dental models.
dental-wax.exampleUsage: The orthodontic patient used dental wax over a rough bracket edge.

retainer.definition: A dental appliance that holds teeth (or a prosthesis) in position after orthodontic treatment.

braces.definition: An appliance that corrects dental irregularities.

mouth-guard.definition: A protective device worn over the teeth to reduce injury during sports or other activities.
mouth-guard.exampleUsage: The athlete wore a fitted mouth guard during the match.

whitening-strip.definition: A thin flexible strip coated with a tooth-whitening product and designed for temporary placement on the teeth.
whitening-strip.exampleUsage: The package explains that whitening strips should be used only as directed.

interdental-brush.definition: A very small brush designed to clean between teeth and around dental appliances.
interdental-brush.exampleUsage: The hygienist demonstrated where an interdental brush can reach.

denture-cleaner.definition: A product designed to clean removable dentures.
denture-cleaner.exampleUsage: The denture cleaner label gives cleaning instructions.

desensitizing-paste.definition: A dental paste formulated to reduce tooth sensitivity by protecting or calming exposed sensitive areas.
desensitizing-paste.exampleUsage: The dentist recommended discussing persistent sensitivity before choosing a desensitizing paste.

dental-cement.definition: A dental material used by professionals to attach, seal, line, or temporarily restore dental structures.
dental-cement.exampleUsage: The dentist selected dental cement for the restoration.

temporary-filling.definition: A short-term dental restoration placed to protect a tooth until a more permanent treatment is completed.
temporary-filling.exampleUsage: The temporary filling protected the tooth until the next appointment.

night-guard.definition: A removable dental appliance worn during sleep to protect teeth from grinding or clenching.
night-guard.exampleUsage: The dentist checked the fit of the night guard.

dentist.definition: A person qualified to practice dentistry.

dental-hygienist.definition: A licensed oral-health professional who cleans teeth, supports preventive care, and educates patients about oral hygiene.
dental-hygienist.exampleUsage: The dental hygienist cleaned the patient's teeth.

dental-assistant.definition: A dental team member who prepares equipment, supports the dentist, and assists with patient care.
dental-assistant.exampleUsage: The dental assistant prepared the treatment room.

receptionist.definition: A secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone and receive visitors.

oral-surgeon.definition: A dentist or physician with specialist training in surgery involving the mouth, jaws, and nearby structures.
oral-surgeon.exampleUsage: The dentist referred the complex case to an oral surgeon.

orthodontist.definition: A dentist specializing in the prevention or correction of irregularities of the teeth.

dental-technician.definition: A skilled professional who makes or repairs dental devices such as crowns, bridges, and dentures, usually in a laboratory.
dental-technician.exampleUsage: The dental technician made the crown from the dentist's specifications.

patient.definition: Enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance.

child-patient.definition: A child who is receiving examination, care, or treatment from a healthcare professional.
child-patient.exampleUsage: The child patient sat with a parent during the visit.

parent.definition: An adult who cares for a child.

periodontist.definition: A dentist specializing in diseases of the gums and other structure surrounding the teeth.

prosthodontist.definition: A dentist who is expert in prosthodontics.

endodontist.definition: A dentist specializing in diseases of the dental pulp and nerve.

pediatric-dentist.definition: A dentist with specialist training in oral healthcare for infants, children, and adolescents.
pediatric-dentist.exampleUsage: The pediatric dentist explained the checkup in simple language.

dental-nurse.definition: A dental-care worker who assists the dentist and supports patients, equipment, and infection-control procedures.
dental-nurse.exampleUsage: The dental nurse prepared sterile instruments.

dental-radiographer.definition: A trained professional who takes dental X-ray images according to clinical and radiation-safety procedures.
dental-radiographer.exampleUsage: The dental radiographer positioned the imaging equipment.

tooth.definition: Something resembling the tooth of an animal.
tooth.exampleUsage: The tooth was identified during the lesson.

molar.definition: Of or pertaining to the grinding teeth in the back of a mammal's mouth.
molar.exampleUsage: The molar was identified during the lesson.

canine.definition: Of or relating to a pointed conical tooth.

incisor.definition: A tooth for cutting or gnawing.

gum.definition: Soft tissue around the base of the teeth.

tongue.definition: A mobile mass of muscular tissue covered with mucous membrane and located in the oral cavity.

jaw.definition: The bones and muscles of the mouth used for biting and chewing.

root.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water.

enamel.definition: Hard white substance covering the crown of a tooth.

crown.definition: (dentistry) dental appliance consisting of an artificial crown for a broken or decayed tooth.

premolar.definition: A tooth having two cusps or points.

wisdom-tooth.definition: One of the last adult molar teeth at the back of the mouth, usually appearing in late adolescence or early adulthood.
wisdom-tooth.exampleUsage: The X-ray showed the position of a wisdom tooth.

baby-tooth.definition: An early tooth that serves a young child until a permanent tooth grows in and replaces it.

palate.definition: The upper surface of the mouth that separates the oral and nasal cavities.

uvula.definition: A small pendant fleshy lobe at the back of the soft palate.

dentin.definition: Bone (calcified tissue) surrounding the pulp cavity of a tooth.

cementum.definition: A specialized bony substance covering the root of a tooth.

periodontal-ligament.definition: The connective tissue fibers that attach a tooth root to the bone of its socket.
periodontal-ligament.exampleUsage: The periodontal ligament helps hold the tooth in its socket.

waiting-room.definition: A room where patients sit until they are called for an appointment.
waiting-room.exampleUsage: The patient waited in the waiting room.

reception-desk.definition: A staffed area in an office, hotel, institution, or support service where visitors and callers are welcomed, identified, and sent to the right person or service.

magazine.definition: A thin publication with articles and pictures, released regularly.

fish-tank.definition: A clear glass or plastic container designed to house pet fish and other water-dwelling life as part of an aquarium.
fish-tank.exampleUsage: The fish tank was identified during the lesson.

certificate.definition: To present someone with a certificate.

appointment-card.definition: A card or document showing the date and time of a scheduled appointment.
appointment-card.exampleUsage: The receptionist wrote the next visit on the appointment card.

insurance-form.definition: A form used to provide information needed for an insurance claim, policy, or coverage check.
insurance-form.exampleUsage: The clinic asked the adult patient to complete an insurance form.

clipboard.definition: A small writing board with a clip at the top for holding papers.

toy-box.definition: A large container designed for keeping toys together between playtimes.

sterilization-room.definition: A dedicated area where reusable dental instruments are cleaned, packaged, and sterilized.
sterilization-room.exampleUsage: Used instruments were taken to the sterilization room.

x-ray-room.definition: A room equipped for taking diagnostic X-ray images with radiation-safety controls.
x-ray-room.exampleUsage: The dental X-ray was taken in the X-ray room.

consultation-room.definition: A private room where a healthcare professional and patient can discuss findings, options, or concerns.
consultation-room.exampleUsage: The dentist discussed the treatment plan in the consultation room.

dental-records.definition: The clinical documents and images that record a patient's dental history, examinations, and treatment.
dental-records.exampleUsage: The clinic keeps dental records securely.

consent-form.definition: A formal document shows that a guardian or student has approved a specific activity or the use of personal information.

treatment-plan.definition: A written guide sets out teaching steps, needed support, and goals for responding to a student's learning or behavior needs.
treatment-plan.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «ترياتمينت بلان»

drill.definition: A tool with a rotating bit used for making holes.
drill.exampleUsage: The drill was used during the activity.

suction.definition: To remove or draw away by the force of suction.

tray.definition: An open receptacle for holding or displaying or serving articles or food.

filling.definition: (dentistry) a dental appliance consisting of any of various substances (as metal or plastic) inserted into a prepared cavity in a tooth.

mouthguard.definition: A protective dental device worn over the teeth to reduce the risk of injury.
mouthguard.exampleUsage: The sports dentist checked the mouthguard fit.

floss.definition: To clean between teeth using a thin thread or strip.

cleaning.definition: The act of making something clean.

cavity.definition: Soft decayed area in a tooth.

extraction.definition: The action of taking out something (especially using effort or force).

sealant.definition: A kind of sealing material that is used to form a hard coating on a porous surface (as a coat of paint or varnish used to size a surface).

impression.definition: (dentistry) an imprint of the teeth and gums in wax or plaster.

anesthesia.definition: Loss of bodily sensation with or without loss of consciousness.
